title: Modification of Use and Bulk Regulations for Zoning Lots Fronting Upon DeLury Square Park
previewText: Where the lot line of a zoning lot coincides with, or is within 20 feet of, the boundary of DeLury Square Park, such lot line shall be considered to be a street line for the purposes of applying all use and bulk regulations of this Resolution.
